name: Slay
source:
You’re the Queen Bee of Belvoire. President of Zeta House. Fashion icon. Campus royalty. Life is basically perfect…until somebody starts murdering your crew.

Rude.

With a slasher tearing through Belvoire’s social hierarchy and your name apparently sitting at the top of their hit list, you’ll have to survive long enough to figure out who wants you dead. And, more importantly, why the hell they think they could get away with ruining your senior year.
